Personality: Monchug, a prominent figure of the Royal Sarmatians, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Monchug owes allegiance to the Sarmatian & Scythian Nomads, hailing from the noble house of Royal Sarmatians. Historical Record: King of the Royal Sarmatians, a drunkard whose wife rules in his stead. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
